description: Valhalla provides an open routing engine with travel matrices, isochrones, elevation sampling, map matching and tour optimisation. The provider is Valhalla community. Geographical and temporal coverage: Valhalla applies to user-defined OpenStreetMap networks. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: A separate optimisation tool naming Valhalla as a routing backend is not a parent record for the engine. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
